user.title: Wake Word Collector
user.description: Record examples of your wake word with your own voice satellites.

data.variants: Also counts as the wake word

data_description.phrase: As your speech-to-text writes it, e.g. Hey Jarvis.
data_description.variants: Comma separated transcriptions that also count, e.g. hey jarvas, hi jarvis. A recording that consists only of these, once or several times, is ready for training; repetitions are split into single clips.
data_description.control_words: Comma separated. Recordings containing them (e.g. "I am done") are kept apart as commands.
data_description.storage: Empty: the folder wake_word_collector/(wake word) in the configuration directory. Recordings are voice data: keep the folder out of public backups.

device_settings.title: Satellite settings
device_settings.description:
Put these into the ESPHome configuration of every satellite (see README):

Upload URL: `{url}`
Token: `{token}`
Command sensor: `sensor.{slug}_satellite_command`

Keep the token secret, e.g. in `secrets.yaml`. It is shown again in the options of this entry.

error.phrase_empty: The wake word must contain at least one letter or digit.

abort.already_configured: This wake word is already set up.

data.variants: Also counts as the wake word

data_description.variants: Comma separated transcriptions that also count, e.g. hey jarvas, hi jarvis. A recording that consists only of these, once or several times, is ready for training; repetitions are split into single clips.

start.name: Start recording
start.description: Puts a satellite into collection mode: every following utterance is recorded until stop.

config_entry_id.name: Wake word entry
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if several wake words are set up.

device.name: Device
device.description: The device name of the satellite (substitution wake_word_device). Empty: the satellite that is running the current voice command.

config_entry_id.name: Wake word entry
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if several wake words are set up.

device.name: Device
device.description: The device name of the satellite (substitution wake_word_device). Empty: the satellite that is running the current voice command.

review.name: Review recording
review.description: Accept a recording for training or reject it (recoverable).

config_entry_id.name: Wake word entry
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if several wake words are set up.

decision.name: Decision
decision.description: accept: usable for training; reject: set aside (recoverable); negative: not the wake word, the model learns to ignore it.

review_latest.name: Review last recording
review_latest.description: Adds a note to the newest usable recording or rejects it.

config_entry_id.name: Wake word entry
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if several wake words are set up.

note.name: Note
note.description: What the user said about it.

trim.name: Trim recording
trim.description: keep: keep the window; remove: cut it out; extract: save it as a new recording and cut it out. The original is kept as backup.

config_entry_id.name: Wake word entry
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if several wake words are set up.

review_latest_trigger.name: Judge the last activation
review_latest_trigger.description: Mark the newest activation reported by a satellite as the wake word or as a false alarm.

decision.name: Decision
decision.description: accept: it was the wake word; negative: false alarm.

start_training.name: Start training
start_training.description: Start a training on the Wake Word Trainer service.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Profile of the trainer service; empty: the selected one.

stop_training.name: Stop training
stop_training.description: Stop the running training; finished rounds stay.

speaker_test.name: Loudspeaker test
speaker_test.description: Let the training computer play one held-out recording through a loudspeaker, to test a satellite live.

route.name: Loudspeaker
route.description: A route of the trainer service's speaker_test configuration.

run_speaker_test.name: Run loudspeaker test
run_speaker_test.description: Play several held-out recordings through a loudspeaker next to a satellite and count how many it recognizes. Returns the result; it also appears in the loudspeaker test sensor.

device.name: Satellite
device.description: Its recording name (wake_word_device). Default: the one chosen in the loudspeaker test select.

route.name: Loudspeaker
route.description: A route of the trainer service. Default: the one last used for this satellite.

satellite.name: Assist satellite
satellite.description: Its assist_satellite entity, if not found automatically from the firmware (faster than waiting for the activation report).

import.name: Import recordings
import.description: Take over existing WAV recordings (mono, 16 bit), e.g. from an earlier training setup, as accepted clips or as negatives. The folder must be in allowlist_external_dirs or below the configuration folder.

category.name: As
category.description: candidates: the wake word; negatives: not the wake word.

device.name: Source name
device.description: Shown like a satellite name, e.g. earlier.
